description: This file defines a Java interface 'ThingsSearchUpdaterPersistence' that extends persistence operations related to the search updater service, including methods to retrieve policy reference tags and outdated thing IDs. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.services.thingsearch.persistence.write package.

classes.name: ThingsSearchUpdaterPersistence
classes.description: A Java interface for persistence operations related to the search updater, including methods to fetch policy reference tags and outdated thing IDs.

methods.name: getPolicyReferenceTags
methods.description: Retrieves modifiable, unsorted list of policy reference tags that match the given policy IDs, returning a reactive stream source.

methods.name: getOutdatedThingIds
methods.description: Retrieves a source of Thing IDs with the specified policy ID and outdated revision.
